Title: Upload receipt
Story: As an Employee, I want to upload a receipt image so that my claim has proof of expense.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a claim line, when I upload a JPG or PDF, then it is attached to the line.

Title: Manager approval
Story: As a Line Manager, I want to approve or reject claims from my team so that valid expenses are reimbursed.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a submitted claim, when I approve it, then the status changes to Approved.

Title: Claim history
Story: As an Employee, I want to see my claim history so that I can track payments.
